The climate in Dresden

Dresden is about 120 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 25°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −1°C. Around 720 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in August (about 74 mm). The highest temperature in Dresden in 2015–2024 was 37°C (19 June 2022) and the lowest −18°C (10 February 2021).

Best time to visit Dresden

The most pleasant weather in Dresden is usually in June, July, August and September: average highs are between 21°C and 25°C, with up to 11 days of rain a month.
